prompt:

Follow this individual scene and camera direction; each game has its own composition and image treatment. Make the meaningful subject LARGE, instantly recognizable at 350-pixel card width, with tactile realistic materials, refined lighting and a compelling professional game-cover finish. Vary surface finish to suit the described scene. No image border, UI, captions, logos, watermarks, letters, numbers, words or equations. Keep the key content within 5% safe margins, retain natural proportions, and make the lighting bright enough to read the objects on mobile.
